registered_at: 2026-10-23, before any script, feature or outcome
batch: untested-categories 2026-10-23 (operator: 'I want to test all of these')
study: Narrow-range / inside day (Crabel's NR7): after a day with the narrowest range of the last 7 that is also inside the prior day's range, buy a break above that day's high; volatility contraction is said to precede expansion.
source: Practitioner (Toby Crabel); no peer-reviewed US-stock test found. Tested for completeness.
data: Warehouse SIP 1-minute bars; daily OHLC per name-day built from RTH bars (09:30-15:59). Needs the 7 prior sessions in the sample for that name.
signal: Day t-1 is NR7 (its high-low range is the smallest of days t-7..t-1) AND inside (high < day t-2 high and low > day t-2 low).
trade: On day t, buy stop at day t-1 high + $0.01 from 09:35 to 15:00 (fill at max(trigger, bar open)); stop loss = day t-1 low (close below exits at next open); exit at the 15:59 close.
control: Same name-day, a seeded random minute 09:35..15:00 with the same percent stop and same exit (seed 'nr7-ctrl').
primary: LIFT = trade - control; and trade net.
pass: In BOTH halves: LIFT >= +5 bp with t >= 2.0 AND mean trade net (after 5 bp) > 0.
no_retuning: NR7, inside rule, window, stop, exit, cost fixed.

common.halves: Warehouse studies: A = 2026-05-11 .. 2026-07-29, B = 2026-07-30 .. 2026-10-15 (110 sessions; 2026-04-27 .. 05-08 are warm-up for look-backs only).
common.statistic_default: Per half: per day, the mean over that day's trades of the measured quantity; day-equal mean; day-clustered t (df = days - 1).
common.cost: 5 bp round trip binding (the desk's current RT cost on $20+ names is ~3 bp); net also printed at 3, 10, 20 bp.
common.price_floor: entry price >= $10 primary; >= $20 (the desk's live floor) as information.
common.confirmation: A PASS is re-run unchanged on warehouse_confirm (2026-01-14 .. 04-24, held out, never read) before anything else; then a forward paper prereg. Never a desk change by itself; the desk stays frozen for the floor20 window.
common.power: Outcome-blind count step first: trades and days per half, and a projected MDE from the dispersion of the CONTROL leg only; floors per half >= 300 trades and >= 20 days, MDE <= the lift bar, else UNDERPOWERED with no outcome read.
common.fail_rule: FAIL: t <= -2 in a half, or the 97.5% upper bound of the lift below the bar in both halves. Otherwise not passed = UNDERPOWERED.
common.data_account: All fetches on the data-only Alpaca account (secrets_data.json), never the desk key; paced; no paid data.
common.multiplicity: Eight studies registered together on 2026-10-23 (the 'untested categories' batch). Each has ONE primary; a family-wise reading is printed: a primary counts as a batch PASS only with t >= 2.73 (Bonferroni 0.05/8, two-sided, normal approx) in both halves; t >= 2 in both halves without that is reported as 'PASS (single-test), not batch-robust'.
amended: (C1) Cross-sectional studies (no control leg): the power MDE comes from a PLACEBO - a seeded random set of the same size as the long set each day (seed '<study>-placebo') minus the all-eligible mean; MDE = (t 2.0 + 0.84) x SD(day placebo LIFT) / sqrt(days). The placebo is outcome-free with respect to the signal.

(C2) No eligibility test may use a bar after entry. Exit price = the close of the last bar at or before the exit minute; a name lacking the exit-minute bar is NOT skipped. A name lacking its entry bar is skipped (counted) - the entry bar is known at entry.
(C3) Confirmation window for fresh-fetch studies: 2026-01-14 .. 2026-04-24 (the warehouse_confirm dates), fetched ONLY after a PASS, never before; no study's scored halves may include it.
(C4) Every fetch logs symbols dropped by rate-limit errors (429) after retries; a half with any unrecovered drop is refused (rerun the fetch).

Universe fact (declared): the warehouse is NOT book-like - it is every liquid name (prior-day raw close >= $10, 20-day mean dollar volume >= $20M, active and inactive, ~1,840-1,950 per day); bars end at 15:59 (no closing auction).

amended.when: 2026-10-23, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST, before any script or data read.
changes: (1) Day ranges come from the FULL warehouse (names present in all 7 prior sessions); scored on the full universe.
(2) CONTROL after the trigger: a seeded random minute in trigger+1 .. trigger+60 (within 15:00), same % stop, same exit.

(3) GAP-THROUGH: a day whose 09:30 open is above the t-1 high is skipped and counted (no buy without a cross from below); the trigger needs a bar whose open is <= the level and whose high > the level.

amended_2.when: 2026-10-23, after result-skeptic round 2 (final), before any script or data read. Each choice is the strict option: no look-back, warm-up or control touches the held-out window 2026-01-14 .. 04-24.
changes: Declared (skeptic round 2): a bar that opens above the level after the prior bar closed below it never triggers (the cross rule needs open <= level); fast breakouts are under-counted.
